status: proposed implementation requirements, not completed runtime features

requirements.text: Separate existing behavior, derived capability and proposed implementation.
Every management data point has source, transport, storage, destination, unit, permission and limitation.
Preserve private saves, photo authorisation and statistics linking as independent systems.
Pin source evidence and never claim proposed routes already exist.
Ordinary, authorised-test and synthetic usage remain distinguishable.
Preserve originating build, device day and late-data provenance.
Every metric exposes denominator, samples, freshness and unavailable state.
Pagination does not cap or mislabel population totals.
Home and drill-downs work in both Studios, EN/VI and mobile layouts.
All new read and write permissions are enforced server-side with explicit role presets.
Attention links an observed signal to versioned evidence, an owner and a next action.
Fixed in code, deployed, verified and reopened remain different states.
Game, website and Studio join by stable catalogue IDs and reviewed source.
Website exports exclude private data and preserve reviewed bilingual detail.
Content/recording coverage names its required catalogue and excludes unsupported claims.
Availability explanation matches actual precedence and distinguishes expected from observed state.
Changes are audited with actor, reason, scope, revision and redacted before/after evidence.
Scoped desktop keys and existing editors do not automatically gain new financial or deploy privileges.
Event writes are schema-validated, transactionally idempotent and conflict-aware.
Attempt outcomes handle retries, orphan events, midnight and conflicting terminals.
New telemetry is bounded, opt-out-aware, nonblocking and contains no child names/private payloads.
Exact funnels/retention/percentiles appear only when their measurement contract is implemented.
Concurrent configuration edits use expected revisions and safe serial projection.
Delivery coverage uses fixed eligible cohorts and preserves offline/unconfirmed devices.
Rollback is compatible, increases revision and never resets progress.
Finance stores integer minor units with original currency, explicit tax basis and FX provenance.
Actuals, estimates, commitments and incomplete imports remain visibly separate.
Financial corrections/imports are private, audited and idempotent without automatic payments.
Provider access, dispatch, terminal outcomes and quotas have explicit state and bounded actions.
Retention and restore operations produce dated evidence of success or failure.
Release preserves website/game/Studio source alignment, compatibility and required checks.
Owner approval, real-device/provider gaps and exact validation outcomes remain explicit.
